hints.title: Invert the Construction Tree
hints.text: View worker splits as internal nodes in a binary tree where leaf nodes correspond to individual blocks.

hints.title: Combine Smallest Blocks First
hints.text: Pair the two blocks that require the least total time and combine them into a single task costing split plus the larger of the two.

hints.title: Use Huffman Tree Greedy Reduction
hints.text: Insert combined nodes back into the collection until one single root node remains.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def minTimeToBuildBlocks(self, blocks: list[int], split: int) -> int:
        heapq.heapify(blocks)
        while len(blocks) > 1:
            _b1 = heapq.heappop(blocks)
            b2 = heapq.heappop(blocks)
            heapq.heappush(blocks, b2 + split)
        return blocks[0]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all worker splitting strategies explores exponential binary tree structures.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Huffman reduction greedily merges smallest time tasks using a priority queue in O(N log N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should draw the connection between worker splitting trees and optimal prefix code / Huffman trees.
complexity.notes: Combining two nodes of times a and b (a <= b) yields a new node of time b + split.
